items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Clearwater Beach. I’m very pleased to have Dave Frishberg with me— [INTERVIEWEE] Thanks, Monk.

ctx.x: Dave was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 16, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
